## Walkthrough

Massive Expo/React Native migration: replaces web layout with an Expo tab app, adds many RN screens/components, charts, hooks, stores, i18n, mock data factories, an ApiClient and DataSourceAdapter, and reorganizes domain models and scoring—removing multiple legacy infra and calculator modules. (50 words)

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Config & Tooling** <br> `/.claude/settings.local.json`, `.gitignore`, `app/babel.config.js`, `app/metro.config.js`, `app/nativewind-env.d.ts`, `app/global.css` | Extended Bash allowlist; ignored `sozai/`; added Babel/Metro for NativeWind/Tailwind; tailwind directives and nativewind types. |
| **Dependencies** <br> `app/package.json` | Added Expo font/icons, blur/haptics/linear-gradient/splash, expo-localization, nativewind, i18n, test deps; bumped expo. |
| **Root & Tab Layout** <br> `app/app/_layout.tsx`, `app/app/(main)/_layout.tsx` | Root: font loading + splash handling (return null while loading). Main: Expo Router tab navigator, custom translucent tab bar, haptics, exported `TAB_BAR_HEIGHT`. |
| **Primary Screens** <br> `app/app/(main)/index.tsx`, `app/app/(main)/rhythm.tsx`, `app/app/(main)/insights.tsx`, `app/app/(main)/breathe.tsx`, `app/app/(main)/settings.tsx`, (deleted) `app/app/(main)/analytics.tsx` | Home → Today screen rewrite; new Rhythm/Insights/Breathe; Settings refactor; Analytics removed. |
| **Detail Screens** <br> `app/app/(main)/action-detail.tsx`, `.../insight-detail.tsx`, `.../sleep-detail.tsx`, `.../recovery-detail.tsx`, `.../rhythm-detail.tsx`, `.../energy-detail.tsx` | Added multiple detail screens with animations, charts, AI explanation blocks and safe-area handling. |
| **Onboarding** <br> `app/app/(onboarding)/*` | Rewrote onboarding (9-step flow), progress segments, decorative blobs, English copy, updated inputs and navigation. |
| **Removed Home components** <br> `app/app/(main)/components/*`, `app/app/(main)/components/index.ts` | Deleted many small Home UI components and removed their barrel exports. |
| **Charts & Visualization** <br> `app/src/components/*` (e.g., `BarChart.tsx`, `CircularProgress.tsx`, `DualRingProgress.tsx`, `HealthAreaChart.tsx`, `RhythmInteractiveChart.tsx`, `MiniBarChart.tsx`) | Added many animated SVG/React Native chart components with touch/tooltip support. |
| **Metric & UI primitives** <br> `app/src/components/{HealthMetricCard,HealthMetricDetail,MetricGridCard,SleepStagesBar,WindowCard,TimeframeSelector,SunInfoCard,PrimaryButton,Card}` | New metric/detail components, UI props updates (Card.noPadding, PrimaryButton.showIcon/isLast), visual token adjustments. |
| **API refactor & types** <br> `app/src/api/{client.ts,types.ts,index.ts}` (removed `app/src/api/config.ts`) | Introduced ApiClient class with ApiResponse, large types overhaul (AdviceRequest/Response, HealthMetrics, ApiError); removed config module. |
| **API helpers & retry removal** <br> `app/src/api/helpers/adviceRequestBuilder.ts`, `app/src/api/utils/*` | buildAdviceRequest now parameterized; removed retry util and its re-export. |
| **Mock data & factories** <br> `app/src/constants/mockDataFactory.ts`, `app/src/constants/mockData/*`, `app/src/config/dataSource.ts`, `app/src/constants/index.ts` | Added deterministic mock factory, comprehensive modular mock datasets (ai/health/screens/user), tests, and data-source toggles (USE_MOCK_*). |
| **Domain models & services** <br> `app/src/domain/models/*`, `app/src/domain/services/*`, `app/src/domain/services/index.ts` | New domain models (aiResponse, rhythm, healthHistory, insight); consolidated scoring (tempoScoreCalculator, new scoreCalculator), added rhythm/energy/alert generators; removed legacy calculators and pressure/location/health repository modules; renamed score fields (autonomic→recovery, activity→energy). |
| **Data adapter & infra removals** <br> `app/src/services/dataSourceAdapter.ts`, removed `app/src/infrastructure/*` | New DataSourceAdapter centralizes mock/real fetching (weather, metrics, AI); removed location/health repository interfaces and mock/Expo implementations. |
| **Stores & hooks** <br> `app/src/stores/*`, `app/src/hooks/*`, `app/src/stores/index.ts` | New persisted HealthStore (Zustand), breatheStore, reworked insightStore (AI-driven + persist), added hooks `useAdvice`, `useWeather`, `useFadeIn`; removed `useNetworkStatus`; updated selectors and store exports. |
| **i18n** <br> `app/src/i18n/*`, `app/src/i18n/locales/ja.json` | Added i18n setup using expo-localization and i18n-js, Japanese locale resources and t/setLocale/getLocale helpers. |
| **Build / styles integration** <br> `app/metro.config.js`, `app/global.css`, `app/nativewind-env.d.ts` | NativeWind/Tailwind integration and typing; injected Tailwind directives and metro input config. |
| **Scripts & tooling helpers** <br> `app/fix-component-types.sh` | New script to insert explicit component prop typing and return types for TSX files. |

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant User
    participant App as TodayScreen
    participant HealthStore
    participant DataAdapter as DataSourceAdapter
    participant API as ApiClient

    User->>App: open Today
    App->>HealthStore: initialize()
    HealthStore->>DataAdapter: getSleepMetrics(), getHRVMetrics(), getActivityMetrics()
    DataAdapter-->>HealthStore: returns MOCK_* (or calls API)
    HealthStore->>DataAdapter: getWeather(lat,lon)
    alt USE_MOCK_WEATHER
        DataAdapter-->>HealthStore: MOCK_WEATHER
    else
        DataAdapter->>API: ApiClient.getWeather(...)
        API-->>DataAdapter: weather response
        DataAdapter-->>HealthStore: mapped weather
    end
    HealthStore->>HealthStore: calculateTempoScore(), calculateCircadianRhythm()
    HealthStore-->>App: updated state
    App->>User: render scores, charts, insights
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant User
    participant InsightsScreen
    participant InsightStore
    participant HealthStore
    participant UserStore
    participant DataAdapter
    participant API as ApiClient

    User->>InsightsScreen: open Insights
    InsightsScreen->>InsightStore: generateDailyInsight()
    InsightStore->>HealthStore: read metrics
    InsightStore->>UserStore: read profile
    InsightStore->>DataAdapter: getAIAdvice(request)
    alt USE_MOCK_AI
        DataAdapter-->>InsightStore: MOCK_AI_RESPONSE
    else
        DataAdapter->>API: apiClient.generateAdvice(request)
        API-->>DataAdapter: advice response
        DataAdapter-->>InsightStore: mapped AdviceResponse
    end
    InsightStore->>InsightStore: setDailyInsight(...), persist
    InsightsScreen->>User: display insight and one-thing
```

  - `screens.ts`: 272行
  - `index.ts`: 17行
- ✅ 全importパスが正しく更新されています

### Phase 1.6: 絶対パス修正
- ✅ コンポーネント内に絶対パスimportは検出されませんでした
- ✅ RhythmInteractiveChart.tsxなども相対パスを使用しています

### Phase 2: 重複コード統合
- ✅ `useFadeIn` hookは`app/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts`に統一され、ローカル定義は削除されています
- ✅ action-detail.tsxのローカル`useFadeIn`は削除されています

### Phase 6: 未使用import削除

- ✅ breathe.tsx: withRepeat, withSequence削除済み
- ✅ Circle import: react-native-svgからの`Circle`は正しく使用されているため問題なし

## ⚠️ 残っている課題

### 1. **health.ts のサイズ超過** ⚠️
```
health.ts: 547行（目標400行を147行超過）
```
さらに細分化が必要です。例えば：
- `health/metrics.ts` (HRV, Sleep, Activity metrics)
- `health/analysis.ts` (RhythmAnalysis, HealthMetrics)
- `health/history.ts` (weekly scores, snapshots)

### 2. **Timeframe型の重複** ⚠️
以下の2ファイルで同じ型が定義されています：
- `app/src/components/HealthMetricDetail.tsx:14`
- `app/src/components/TimeframeSelector.tsx:15`

**推奨**: TimeframeSelectorの型を使用し、HealthMetricDetailからは削除してTimeframeSelectorからimportする

### 3. **PrimaryButton.tsx の未使用import** ⚠️
```typescript
// app/src/components/PrimaryButton.tsx
import { Colors, BorderRadius, Spacing, FontFamily } from '../theme';
// ↑ BorderRadius と Spacing がコード内で使用されていません
```

### 4. **settings.tsx のSection component** ℹ️
`Section`コンポーネントがsettings.tsx内にローカル定義されています。他のファイルで使用されていないため、これはローカルのままでも問題ありませんが、今後複数の場所で使う予定があれば共有コンポーネント化を検討してください。
